name: Mains Essay Paper
description: Philosophical, Socio-economic, Governance, Science, Geopolitics, and Environmental themes (Section A & Section B)
subject: Essay

units.name: Core Essay Archetypes & Brainstorming Frameworks
units.description: Philosophical abstracts, Quote-based prompts, PESTLE + SPECLIST expansion

topics.name: Philosophical & Abstract Essays (Section A Focus)
subtopics: Deconstructing metaphorical prompts ('Ships do not sink because of water around them...')
Multi-dimensional thesis formulation (Individual, Societal, National, Global)
Anecdote and hook openings, dialectical synthesis (Thesis - Antithesis - Synthesis)

topics.name: Socio-Economic, Technology & Environmental Essays (Section B Focus)
subtopics: Artificial Intelligence, Ethics & The Future of Human Labor
Climate Justice, Common but Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR)
Federalism, Inclusive Growth & Women-led Development

name: UPSC Optional Subjects Master Directory
description: Official syllabus specifications for 18 premier Optional Subjects (Paper 1 & Paper 2)
subject: Optional

units.name: Political Science and International Relations (PSIR)
units.description: Political Theory, Indian Politics, Comparative Politics, International Relations

topics.name: Political Theory & Indian Nationalism
subtopics: Western Political Thought (Plato, Aristotle, Machiavelli, Hobbes, Locke, Mill, Marx, Gramsci, Arendt)
Indian Political Thought (Dharmashastra, Arthashastra, Buddhist traditions, Gandhi, Ambedkar, Roy)
Indian Government & Politics (Constitution, Federalism, Party System, Grassroots movements)

topics.name: Comparative Politics & International Relations
subtopics: Realism, Liberalism, Marxist & Feminist theories of IR
Global institutions (UN, IMF, WTO), Nuclear doctrine, India's Foreign Policy with USA, China, Russia, Neighbors

topics.name: Sociological Thinkers & Social Stratification
subtopics: Marx (Historical Materialism, Alienation), Durkheim (Division of Labor, Suicide, Religion), Weber (Social Action, Ideal Types, Bureaucracy, Protestant Ethic), Parsons, Merton, Mead
Stratification (Caste, Class, Gender, Race), Work & Economic Life, Politics & Society

topics.name: Indian Society: Structure and Change
subtopics: GS Ghurye, MN Srinivas (Sanskritization, Dominant Caste), AR Desai
Caste movements, Agrarian class structure, Tribal communities, Industrialization & Urbanization in India

units.name: Geography Optional
units.description: Principles of Geography (Physical & Human) & Geography of India

topics.name: Physical & Human Geography Principles
subtopics: Geomorphology (Davis/Penck cycles, Plate Tectonics), Climatology, Oceanography, Biogeography
Human Geography: Models & Theories (Christaller, Weber, Rostow, Heartland/Rimland)

topics.name: Geography of India (Physical, Resources, Regional Planning)
subtopics: Physiographic regions, River interlinking, Agro-climatic regionalization, Mineral belts, Multilevel planning

units.name: History Optional
units.description: Ancient & Medieval India (Paper 1), Modern India & World History (Paper 2)

topics.name: Sources, Archaeology, Early State Formation & Medieval Polity
subtopics: Map-pointing (Ancient sites, Ashokan edicts, Megalithic culture)
Mauryan, Gupta, Chola administrations, Delhi Sultanate & Mughal Agrarian System

topics.name: Colonial Economy, Freedom Struggle & World History
subtopics: Commercialization of agriculture, De-industrialization, Peasant movements, Partition
Enlightenment, French Revolution, Russian Revolution, Imperialism and Fascism

topics.name: Administrative Thinkers & Paradigms
subtopics: Taylor, Fayol, Weber, Follett, Elton Mayo, Simon, Riggs (Prismatic Model)
NPM (New Public Management), Public Choice, Good Governance, Accountability

topics.name: Indian Administration & District Administration
subtopics: Kautilyan legacy, Mughal & British legacy, PMO, Cabinet Secretariat, ARC recommendations, District Collector role

units.name: Anthropology Optional
units.description: Physical Anthropology, Socio-Cultural Anthropology & Indian Tribal Culture

topics.name: Human Evolution, Genetics & Cultural Theories
subtopics: Fossil records (Australopithecus, Homo erectus, Neanderthal), Mendelism, Chromosomal aberrations
Marriage, Family, Kinship, Economic/Political/Religious organizations, Anthropological Theories

topics.name: Indian Anthropology & Tribal Development
subtopics: Indian Paleolithic/Mesolithic/Neolithic cultures, Caste-Tribe continuum, PVTGs, Tribal problems (Land alienation, Health, Education), Xaxa Committee
